metadata.name: GetCardDetails
metadata.description: Use this API to get details of card which includes monetary details like Balance, Last load amount,outstanding authrization, Dispute amount and non monetary details like Account manual status,Branch name, OFAC score, card activation date.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: Bsegment
children.description: Gets or sets Bsegment.

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account Number. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: Current balance after transaction, Valid Values:0-9 Example: 50.00

children.name: OFACScore
children.description: Score received after OFAC Checks. Example : 2

children.name: TotalOutStgAuthAmt
children.description: Total outstanding authorization Amount. Example : 100

children.name: AvailableBalance
children.description: Available balance on the account Valid values : 0-9 Example: 100.50

children.name: LastBulkOFACCheckDate
children.description: Date and time of periodic OFAC Check of the accounts present in the system Format:yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: LastTransactionDate
children.description: Date of Last transaction posted on account Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: OFACInquiryDate
children.description: OFAC Inquiry Date Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: SavingAccountNumber
children.description: If the account has multiple saving account, then This tag will return latest saving account details. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: SavingAccountCurrentBalance
children.description: If the account has multiple saving account, then This tag will return latest saving account details. Example: 1220

children.name: OverDraftStatus
children.description: Current status of Overdraft facility of account. Valid Values : 1 = Opt-in 2 = Opt-out

children.name: AllowedPINAccess
children.description: PIN Transaction allowed or not Valid values : 0  = Allow 1  = Do not Allow Example: 1

children.name: CashAccessAllowed
children.description: Cash access Transaction allowed or not. Valid values: 0 = No, 1= Yes Example: 1

children.name: LexNexInquiryDate
children.description: Lexis Nexis Inquiry Date Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: BranchID
children.description: Branch ID Valid values: 0-9 Example: 1001

children.name: BranchName
children.description: Branch name Example : Georgia Branch Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CardGeneratedStatus
children.description: Generated Status of Card Example :New Card Pending Activation Allowable Values: 40

children.name: AccountManualStatus
children.description: Account Manual Status Example: Fraud Suspicious Allowable Values: 40

children.name: AccountGeneratedStatus
children.description: Generated Status of account Example :Active Allowable Values: 40

children.name: ParentAccountNumber
children.description: Parent Account Number Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: PurchaseAmountOfLastTransaction
children.description: Amount of last Purchase on account Example: 1001

children.name: DateOfLastLoad
children.description: Date when the card was last loaded Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: DisputeAmount
children.description: Disputed amount on the card Example : 100

children.name: LastLoadAmount
children.description: Last Load Amount which was posted on account

children.name: OverDraftAmount
children.description: This flag will display the Amount of overdraft allowed for Account.

children.name: OFACMatchedBy
children.description: Entity with which Account marked as OFAC. Valid Values:  Primary and Secondary Example: Primary

children.name: DirectDepositAdvanceAmount
children.description: Amount given in advance to cardholder, repaid/debited automatically from the next Payroll deposit on the cardholder account.

children.name: ImmediatePostACH
children.description: Flag to indicate the posting of Future dated ACH Transaction will be done on effective date. Valid Value: - 1= Not Allowed, 2 = All Credits and 3= Credits – Payroll Example:- 1

children.name: Embossing
children.description: Gets or sets Embossing Data.

children.name: CardExpiryDate
children.description: Expiration Date of the card. Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: CardNumber4Digits
children.description: Last  4 digits of the card. Valid values : 0-9 Example : 4386

children.name: PendingCardExpDate
children.description: Expiration Date of activation pending card Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: CardSequenceNumber
children.description: Card Sequence Number Valid Values:0-9 Example: 03

children.name: SecondaryCardType
children.description: Type of secondary card Valid Values:0-2 0 = Regular Card 1 = Virtual Card 2 = Family Card Example: 0 (Regular Card) Allowable Values: 25

children.name: VirtualCardLimit
children.description: Virtual card Limit when SecondaryCardType = 1 Family Card Usage Limit when SecondaryCardType = 2 Example : 100

children.name: VirtualCardResetLimitAllowed
children.description: Resetting of Virtual card Limit is allowed or not Valid values : 0 = Allow 1 = Do not Allow

children.name: VirtualCardResetAllowed
children.description: Virtual Card Reset Allowed or not Valid Values  0:Yes, 1 : No Example : 1

children.name: VirtualCardExpiryOption
children.description: Virtual Card Expiry Option Valid values are 0,1,2 0 :- Card will expire after n number of transaction 1 :- Card will expire after n number of days/hour/Minutes/Month/Weeks/years 2 :- Card will expire on particular date

children.name: FraudSuspicious
children.description: Account is Fraud suspicious or not 1 - Yes 2 - No

children.name: CardHandoverDate
children.description: Card handover Date Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: EmbossCardStatus
children.description: Card's embossing status Example : Embossed

children.name: CardActivationDate
children.description: Date of card activation Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example: 2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: PlasticCode
children.description: Plastic Code Valid values:0-9 Example: 32

children.name: PlasticName
children.description: Plastic Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z Example : CashCard Allowable Values: 50

children.name: DerivedStatus
children.description: Status which is derived by considering Card Status (manual and generated) ,account status (manual and generated) and Card plastic status Example: Active

children.name: FailedLinkCardAttempts
children.description: Counter of failed link card attempts Example : 3

children.name: LinkCardAttemptsProduct
children.description: Number of link card attempts defined on product. Example : 3

children.name: InvalidActivationEnrollmentAttempts
children.description: Counter of invalid attempts of activation and enrollment process. Example : 3

children.name: InvalidAccessCodeAttempts
children.description: Counter of invalid access code attempts. Example : 3

children.name: ProxyNumber
children.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: CardLockUnlockStatus
children.description: Flag to set card lock unlock status. Valid values : 0: Card Unlocked 1: Card Locked Example: 1

children.name: HoldEmbossing
children.description: Tag to decide physical card or virtual card by holding embossing file. Valid Values: 0 - No (Physical card) 1 - Yes (Virtual card)

children.name: VirtualCardAvailableLimit
children.description: Available Virtual Card Limit shows the available limit after spending from Total Virtual Card Limit. Condition: SecondaryCardType = 1 then this options will be applicable Example 100,200

children.name: UserInformation
children.description: Gets or sets User Information.

children.name: UserId
children.description: UserId of the cardholder Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,0-9. Example : Sam Allowable Values: 40

children.name: UserFirstName
children.description: First Name of user Example : John

children.name: UserLastName
children.description: Last Name of user Example : Morris

children.name: LastLoginDate
children.description: Date of Last login Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: FailedAccessCodeChangeAttempts
children.description: Counter of  failed access code change attempts. Example : 3

children.name: LinkCardChecked_User
children.description: Display or not to display the link card option of the primary card to the user. Valid values : 0 = Do no display Link card option 1 = Display Link card Option

children.name: LinkCardChecked_Secondaycard_User
children.description: Display or not to display the link card option for secondary card to the user. Valid values : 0 = Do no display Link card option 1 = Display Link card option Example : 1

children.name: DelinkCardChecked_User
children.description: Display or not to display the Delink card option of the primary card to the user. Valid values : 0 = Do no display Delink card option 1 = Display Deink card option

children.name: DelinkCardChecked_SecondaryCard_User
children.description: Display or not to display the Delink card option for secondary card to the user. Valid values : 0 = Do no display Link card option 1 = Display Link card option Example : 1

children.name: LinkCardChecked_Product
children.description: Display or not to display the link card option of the primary card as per product setting Valid values : 0 = Do no display Link card option 1 = Display Link card option

children.name: LinkCardChecked_SecondayCard_Product
children.description: Display or not to display the link card option of the secondary card as per product setting. Valid values : 0 = Do no display Link card option 1 = Display Link card option

children.name: DelinkCardChecked_Product
children.description: Display or not to display the Delink card option for primary card as per product setting. Valid values : 0 = Do no display Link card option 1 = Display Link card option Example : 1

children.name: DelinkCardChecked_SecondaryCard_Product
children.description: Display or not to display the Delink card option of the secondary card as per product setting. Valid values : 0 = Do no display Link card option 1 = Display Link card option

children.name: Customer
children.description: Gets or sets Customer Data.

children.name: CustomerId
children.description: Unique ID associated with Customer Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: abc2123

children.name: MaskedSocialSecurityNumber
children.description: Social Security number in masked form Example : *****5645

children.name: DateofBirth
children.description: DOB of cardholder Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example :2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: HomePhoneNumber
children.description: Home Phone Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9812338769

children.name: WorkPhoneNumber
children.description: Cardholder  Work Phone Number Valid values:0-9 Example:9632581470

children.name: MobilePhoneNumber
children.description: Cardholder's Mobile Phone Number Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9876543210

children.name: EMailAddress1
children.description: E Mail Address 1 of Cardholder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @ . Example: sem_pp1 @gmail.com Allowable Values: 40

children.name: EMailAddress2
children.description: E Mail Address 2 of Card holder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @ . Example :  sem_pp1 @gmail.com Allowable Values: 40

children.name: OtherIdCountry
children.description: Allowable Values: 5

children.name: OtherIDExpiryDate
children.description: Expiration date of ID Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: OtherIDIssueDate
children.description: Indicates the Date of any other ID verification document which was issued. Valid Values:0-9 Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: OtherIdState
children.description: ID Issue State Valid Values:Two Digit State Code:A-Z,a-z Example:GA Condition:This field is mandatory when IDName=  02,07 and Country = US Appendix Section: Refer Appendix Section : State Codes(US)

children.name: HomePhExtension
children.description: Home Phone Number Extension Valid Values:0-9 Example:91

children.name: AlertEmailAddress
children.description: Email address of the cardholder where alert should be sent Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example : Core @gmail.com Allowable Values: 40

children.name: MemberId
children.description: This tag indicates MemberID Example : ABCD112 Allowable Values: 40

children.name: OFACInquiryDate
children.description: OFAC Inquiry Date Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: OFACScore
children.description: Score received after OFAC Checks. Example : 2

children.name: SDNEntry1
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: SDNEntry2
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: SDNEntry3
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: SDNEntry4
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: SDNEntry5
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: PreviousOFACScore
children.description: Previous OFAC Score. Example:85

children.name: OFACClearanceDate
children.description: DateTime when the Account manually cleared from the OFAC status to Active status or to the status which was set before OFAC status. Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: Address
children.description: Gets or sets Address.

children.name: Addressline1
children.description: Address Line 1 of the Cardholder Valid values : A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 40

children.name: Addressline2
children.description: Address Line 2 of the Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 mecca way Allowable Values: 40

children.name: City
children.description: Cardholder's City of residence Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Allowable Values: 25

children.name: State
children.description: Cardholder State of residence Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes(US) Allowable Values: 5

children.name: Country
children.description: Two Character Country Code Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values Allowable Values: 5

children.name: Postalcode
children.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: Logo
children.description: Gets or sets Logo.

children.name: ProductName
children.description: Product Name of card Example: Spend Product

children.name: FamilyCardAllow
children.description: Family Card is allowed for this product or not. Valid Values : 0 = Allow 1 = Do not Allow Example : 1

children.name: AdditionalCard
children.description: Gets or sets Additional Card.

children.name: NameOnCard
children.description: Name to be Embossed on Card Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9. Example: Hudson M Charles Allowable Values: 23
